name: Belgium

flag.description: Three equal vertical stripes of black, yellow and red from the hoist, in an unusual near-square 13:15 ratio.
flag.symbolism: The colours come from the arms of the Duchy of Brabant: a golden lion with red claws and tongue on a black field.

hook: Belgium is Germany's black, yellow and red standing upright: vertical stripes with black at the flagpole, versus Germany's horizontal stack.
trivia: The official proportion of 13:15 is rarely seen; most Belgian flags in everyday use are made in the common 2:3 shape.
Belgium has three official languages: Dutch, French and German.
